predicate_contract: Read the current persisted controller status and exact resource claim.
Require their controller PID/creation ownership to agree.
Build the live process parent chain from that exact controller identity.
Exclude only those exact PIDs from the relevant-process scan.
Fail on every relevant process outside that identity-bound chain.
evidence_contract: Use a Python supervisor distinct from the verifier.
Initialize start time and metadata before spawn.
Capture Popen PID and observed creation identity before waiting.
Capture the actual wait return code and end time.
Publish process metadata in a finally path with stdout/stderr hashes.
Never infer the exit code from verifier stdout.
